DREAM WORKER — Issue #87: Add A2A Journey Timing

## Instructions
1. Read the wish file: .wishes/087-a2a-journey-timing-wish.md
2. Branch from dev: git checkout dev && git pull origin dev && git checkout -b feat/a2a-journey-timing
3. Execute ALL execution groups in order (A → B → C):
   - Group A: Expose timing methods on A2AChannelPlugin, update A2AHandlerContext with plugin reference
   - Group B: Add T0/T1/T2 capture to message/send and message/stream handler paths. Document that A2A T0 is synthetic (Date.now() at request receipt) since A2A is synchronous HTTP with no platform timestamp
   - Group C: Run make check validation
4. Run the validation commands from the wish file after each group
5. Run make check — if it fails, fix and retry (max 3 attempts)
6. Once CI green, create PR: gh pr create --base dev --title "feat(channel-a2a): add T0/T1/T2 journey timing (GH#87)" --body "..."
7. Report back: DONE with PR URL, or BLOCKED with reason

IMPORTANT: Do NOT push to main. PR must target dev.
